newsitem.title: INDIA: India railway minister not to quit over crash.
newsitem.headline: India railway minister not to quit over crash.

text.p: Indian Railway Minister Ram Vilas Paswan said on Wednesday he could not be blamed for a train crash on the outskirts of New Delhi that killed 13 people.
"I will not resign. I cannot be responsible for a (train) driver's fault. Some things are beyond one's control and there is nothing one can do to stop it," Paswan told a news conference.
Railway officials said Monday's collision was caused by human error when the speeding Karnataka Express overshot a stop sign on a loop sign and rammed into the slower-moving Himsagar Express.
Paswan said if chief ministers of Indian states were held responsible for every road accident that occurred in their states, they would be resigning every day.
"What we need to do is to take this matter seriously and take precautionary measures. There will be no compromises on passenger safety," he added.
